newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money firms to 3.05/3.10 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money firms to 3.05/3.10 percent.

text.p: German call money rates firmed to 3.05/3.10 percent on Monday from Friday'S 3.02/3.07 percent as commercial banks' reserves at the Bundesbank declined, dealers said. Most trades were done at 3.10 percent.

Reserves on Friday, the latest figures available, totalled 35.9 billion marks, down from Wednesday's 37.7 billion and well below the estimated October reserve requirement of 39.3 billion marks, dealers said.
The average for the month through Sunday was down at 37.2 billion marks, compared with 38.6 billion on Thursday.
Lombard borrowings on Friday were about 100 million marks.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was 3.10400 percent on Monday, up from 3.08483 percent on Friday.
